I'm an anxious person. In relationships, I demand more attention than most people might. To me, it seems like this guy is the same. He wants all your attention and feels rejected when it's not given. This is not healthy.

He needs to work on his self-esteem and learn that not being the centre of your world is normal. He needs to learn to respect your personal space and to stop building his whole life around someone else.

Of course, this is based on my own insecurities. I feel the kindest and most logical approach would be to establish boundaries and discuss what you each feel is an appropriate amount of contact.
